verdict.rationale: Sidecar is documented as letting a paired iPad act as a secondary display/tablet for creative Mac apps, explicitly citing use with InDesign, Affinity Photo, and ZBrush, plus Apple Pencil support; Universal Control complements this by letting cursor/keyboard move fluidly between Mac and iPad. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of Sidecar's reliability and any designer-specific reviews of the workflow.
